question: Which Tennessee receiver caught all five of Hendon Hooker's touchdown passes in the Vols' 52-49 upset of No. 3 Alabama in October 2022?
explanation: Hyatt piled up 207 receiving yards and a school-record five touchdowns as Tennessee snapped a 15-year losing streak to Alabama, and he went on to become the first Vol to win the Biletnikoff Award.

question: Carson Beck hurt his throwing arm on the last play of the first half of the December 2024 SEC Championship Game against Texas. Which Georgia quarterback came off the bench to lead the comeback?
explanation: Stockton steered Georgia back from a 6-3 halftime deficit; Beck returned for a goal-line handoff in overtime, when Trevor Etienne's touchdown run won it 22-19 in the first overtime game in SEC title game history.

question: Who caught Bryce Young's 28-yard touchdown pass with 24 seconds left to force overtime in the November 2021 Iron Bowl at Auburn?
explanation: Brooks, a true freshman, had the catch of his career, and Alabama went on to win 24-22 in four overtimes, the first overtime game in Iron Bowl history.

question: Who won the 2019 Outland Trophy as college football's top interior lineman?
explanation: The Oregon tackle won it as a sophomore, the first Duck ever to take the Outland, and later went seventh overall to Detroit in the 2021 NFL Draft.

question: LSU's Greedy Williams and Notre Dame's Julian Love were finalists for the 2018 Jim Thorpe Award. Who beat them for it?
explanation: Baker became the first Georgia player to win the Thorpe as the nation's top defensive back and was also named a Walter Camp All-American that season.

question: Pitt, a 28-point underdog, beat No. 2 West Virginia 13-9 in December 2007 to knock the Mountaineers out of the BCS title game. Which Pitt quarterback scored the Panthers' touchdown on a 1-yard run?
explanation: West Virginia was hampered by star quarterback Pat White dislocating his thumb in the second quarter, and the Mountaineers failed twice on fourth down after he returned.

question: Who was named player of the game in the January 2001 Rose Bowl, Washington's 34-24 win over Drew Brees and Purdue?
explanation: The Huskies' senior quarterback outdueled Brees, the Big Ten champions' star quarterback, a few months before Brees went to San Diego at the top of the 2001 NFL Draft's second round.

question: San Diego State's Rashaad Penny led FBS in rushing in 2017. How many rushing yards did he finish with, bowl game included?
explanation: Penny closed with 221 yards against Army in the Armed Forces Bowl for the fifth-most in an FBS season at the time, also scored on two kickoff returns, and went 27th overall to Seattle in 2018.

question: Northern Illinois' Jordan Lynch broke the FBS single-season rushing record for a quarterback in 2013. How many rushing yards did he finish with?
explanation: Lynch topped his own 1,815 from 2012 and Denard Robinson's 1,702 from 2010, set the single-game quarterback mark twice that year (316, then 321 yards) and finished third in the Heisman voting.

question: Kansas State's Michael Bishop finished second to Ricky Williams in the 1998 Heisman voting. At which junior college did he win two national titles before arriving in Manhattan?
explanation: Bishop went 24-0 at Blinn under coach Willie Fritz, winning NJCAA titles in 1995 and 1996, and was a seventh-round pick of the New England Patriots in 1999.
